method: Seeded sample of a bounded archive prefix; not a representative sample of all chess or all Lichess.
filters: Standard legal nonterminal positions; deepest available evaluation >=15; finite cp labels with abs(cp)<=1000; mate labels excluded.
target: White-perspective engine centipawns divided by 100; positive favors White. Engine estimates, not outcome probabilities.
split: 80/10/10 by unique piece placement, seed 314. No game IDs in this export, so no game-disjoint guarantee. Related positions may remain.
